services.desc: At East Wind Academy, we offer the most realistic and advanced martial arts training available. We are different from other martial arts facilities in that we offer certified instruction in a variety of styles all in one location. With arts from Thailand, Korea, China and Southeast Asia, East Wind Academy of Martial Arts is your complete training center. This is our core class, and the bread and butter of our gym. This class is our blended system where you will be exposed to many different styles of martial arts, including Wing Chun, Kali, Jeet Kune Do, and more.
